Steps.Description: On the Gravenmarsh Causeway, Kesh of Reed-End presses a sealed letter and a silver signet into the player's hand. 'Drest. Eyes only. Not Varn. Especially not Varn.'
AvailableChoices: accept: Take the letter and swear by the signet.
Steps.ChosenChoiceText: Take the letter and swear by the signet.

Steps.Description: At Gravenhold's outer gate, Lieutenant Varn intercepts. 'The Commander's schedule is tight. I'll take that.' His hand is already out.
AvailableChoices: hand-over: Hand the letter to Varn.
RequirementWarnings: forced choice 'past-varn' not found at beat 'gate-arrival'; falling back.

Steps.Description: A day later: Kesh is found face-down in the bog. 'Exposure,' the bogmen say. Drest summons the player. Calm. Asks what was in the letter the player never delivered.
AvailableChoices: confess: Confess. Varn took it. You didn't know.
lie-caught: Lie. Drest catches it (his intent-read assumed).
Steps.ChosenChoiceText: Confess. Varn took it. You didn't know.
RequirementWarnings: forced choice 'bribe-scribe' not found at beat 'beat-2a-summons'; falling back.

Steps.Description: Drest nods once. 'You will be of use.' Varn is now a marked problem. Chain ends with Varn-treachery seed planted.
